clips.title: The story
paras: On Westfall's cliffs, Daphne Stilwell keeps an orchard above the Longshore. She and her husband Jordan fled the north and now aid the Church of the Holy Light while guarding their home from nearby outlaws.

West of Moonbrook and the Deadmines exit, Daphne Stilwell tends a homestead and apple orchard on the bluffs. From the Longshore below or gryphon routes south to Stranglethorn Vale above, the farm looks quiet. But life there is not safe. Bandits and scavengers roam nearby, while Daphne works among the trees and watches over her isolated land.

Before coming to Westfall, Daphne and her husband Jordan lived in Lordaeron near Pyrewood Village, where they worked in what is now Shadowfang Keep. Darkness and disaster drove them south with thousands of other human refugees. Near Stormwind, Jordan's renowned skill as a craftsman and Daphne's steady presence brought them close to the Church of the Holy Light. They support the church and provide holy arms to paladins of the Silver Hand.
